# Red Horse Combat Sports

Kickboxing gym in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma (legal name Red Horse Combat Sports LLC; formerly listed as Red Horse Kickboxing).

> Beginner-friendly kickboxing group classes, private training and youth programs.
> Your first class is free.

## Contact

- Address: 3718 NW 50th St, Oklahoma City, OK 73112
- Phone: (405) 361-5815
- Email: cody@redhorsecs.com
- Classes (Monday to Friday): Youth 3–4 PM, Conditioning (everyone) 4–5 PM, Advanced 5–6 PM, Beginner 6–7 PM
- Saturday: Open training 10–11 AM

## Pricing

- First class: free
- Drop-in: $20 a class
- Membership: $125 a month
- Kids membership: $50 a month
